condition.notes: Output ripple exceeds the rail's limit (rail-defined, or 50 mV default). The DC reading may be fine but the AC content is too high. Common cause: output cap ESR high (dried electrolytic).

next_steps.action: Ripple exceeds the limit. Measure the output cap ESR and replace if high. A dried electrolytic is the most common cause. If ESR is normal, suspect loop instability (compensation network).

measure.expected: Ripple within the rail's spec; ESR < 0.1 ohm (polymer) or < 0.5 ohm (aluminium).

interpretations.then: Replace the output cap with a low-ESR part of the same value+voltage.

interpretations.if_result: ESR normal but ripple still high
interpretations.then: Loop instability or load transients. Check compensation network (controller datasheet).
